title: Identification of COL8A2, MICAL2, and TNFSF10 as potential biomarkers associated with both exercise response and osteoarthritis: a multi-omics integration study.
authors: Wang, Hongyuan; Lu, Huaimin; Zhou, Xun; Tian, Ye; Dan, Jing; Li, Yan; Li, Xiaodong; Wang, Jiahao; Li, Lengtao
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学整合和机器学习识别骨关节炎与运动反应相关的生物标志物，虽涉及分子对接但核心是基因表达与诊断标志物，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: To identify molecular biomarkers associated with both osteoarthritis (OA) pathology and exercise response through multi-omics integration. Bulk RNA-seq, exercise transcriptomics, and single-cell RNA-seq datasets were integrated. Machine learning algorithms, Mendelian randomization, and molecular docking were employed to identify and validate key genes. Single-cell analysis revealed regulatory chondrocytes (RegC) were significantly enriched in OA tissues with enhanced intercellular communication activity. Integration of OA-related genes, exercise-responsive genes, and RegC markers identified 86 overlapping candidates. Machine learning algorithms converged on three key genes: COL8A2, MICAL2, and TNFSF10, all showing significant upregulation in OA across multiple datasets with good diagnostic performance. These genes were specifically expressed in RegC cells and enriched in mechanosensitive pathways including MAPK, TNF, and FoxO signaling. They displayed distinct immune cell correlation patterns and were regulated through complex networks involving competing endogenous RNAs and transcription factors. Mendelian randomization confirmed causal associations between all three genes and OA risk. Molecular docking identified multiple potential therapeutic compounds targeting these genes. Expression upregulation was validated in human OA cartilage samples. Through multi-omics integration analysis, this study identifies COL8A2, MICAL2, and TNFSF10 as genes that are differentially expressed in both OA progression and exercise response. These genes may represent potential molecular links between exercise and OA, warranting further investigation of their regulatory mechanisms. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s13205-025-04685-9.
abstract_zh: 为了通过多组学整合识别与骨关节炎（OA）病理及运动反应相关的分子生物标志物。整合了批量RNA测序、运动转录组学和单细胞RNA测序数据集。采用机器学习算法、孟德尔随机化和分子对接来识别并验证关键基因。单细胞分析显示，调节性软骨细胞（RegC）在OA组织中显著富集，并具有增强的细胞间通讯活性。整合OA相关基因、运动反应基因和RegC标记物，鉴定出86个重叠候选基因。机器学习算法聚焦于三个关键基因：COL8A2、MICAL2和TNFSF10，这些基因在多个数据集的OA中均显著上调，并具有良好的诊断性能。这些基因在RegC细胞中特异性表达，并富集于机械敏感通路，包括MAPK、TNF和FoxO信号通路。它们表现出不同的免疫细胞相关性模式，并通过涉及竞争性内源RNA和转录因子的复杂网络进行调控。孟德尔随机化确认了所有三个基因与OA风险之间的因果关联。分子对接识别出多个靶向这些基因的潜在治疗化合物。在人类OA软骨样本中验证了表达上调。通过多组学整合分析，本研究将COL8A2、MICAL2和TNFSF10识别为在OA进展和运动反应中均差异表达的基因。这些基因可能代表运动与OA之间的潜在分子联系，值得进一步研究其调控机制。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可访问10.1007/s13205-025-04685-9获取。
